name: Gradient-guided single scattering approximation
aliases: GPU Based On-the-fly Light Emission-absorption Approximation
definition: A GPU-based direct volume rendering method that approximates single scattering and shadowing on-the-fly for multiple intersecting volumetric datasets, using local gradients to guide scatter sample positions and in-scatter coefficients to improve visual quality over local illumination models while maintaining interactive frame rates.
summary: A GPU-based volume rendering method that approximates single scattering on-the-fly by using local gradients to guide sample positions and coefficients, improving visual quality while maintaining interactive frame rates.
